sections.h2: Open investigations rose by 244 as intake outran completions

chart.title: Investigations taken up outpaced completions in both recent years
chart.sub: SEBI investigations, cases per year. Completed includes older cases.
chart.source: SEBI annual reports as reported by PTI, Business Standard, Moneylife and Factly.

sections.means: Intake has run ahead of completions in both recent years, so open cases keep piling up.
sections.todo: Add investigators so completions keep pace with the 400 cases taken up in 2024-25.

sections.h2: The committee would double the 180-day deadline to one year

events: Code introduced with a 180-day deadline and unlimited extensions
Standing Committee reports, asking for one year

sections.means: The committee's one-year limit is closer to real timelines, which PRS says run one to one-and-a-half years.
sections.todo: Adopt the one-year deadline and stop the Code allowing unlimited extensions.
